title.description: The title to display within the item.

tooltip.description: The tooltip to display when hovered.

subMenu.description: The submenu for the navigation item.

icon.description: Optional name of the FontAwesome icon to display within the item.

redirectRoute.description: Optional route to redirect to when the item is clicked.

hoveredSubMenu.description: Optional submenu that should appear when the mouse hovers over the item.

title: A UI component type to represent a single item within the navigation menu.
name: UiSdlNavMenuItem
